    | text      = In his recent show Alex spent a long time deflecting criticism that had popped up in the right wing media about the Trump administration working with Palantir to create a database of U.S. citizens.

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:03.680

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:48.679
    | text      = or at very least, you delay having to make a firm decision on this by focusing on Mike Johnson.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:54.679

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:04.679
    | text      = But in this clip, we also see a glaring problem, which is that Chase is not Alex, and he shouldn't be trying to do an Alex impression.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:11.679

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:16.679
    | text      = That's territory that Alex has claimed, because even the people who like him kind of understand that he's nuts.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:22.679
    | text      = Alex's performance relies on the audience being aware that he's a little insane, and that's because he knows too much and he's seen too much.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:29.679
    | text      = God has given him these visions that he's had to carry like a cross for his whole life, and for the last 30 years, he's had to live with the crown of thorns that comes with the public derision that's been on his head.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:39.679
    | text      = Alex is a little bit unwell, which is why he drifts into characters and he can't control himself from calling everyone he doesn't like a pedophile or a demon.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:47.679
    | text      = Chase isn't the same guy, so when he tries to put on Alex's affectations, it looks really stupid.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:53.679
    | text      = What makes Alex an effective propagandist isn't the same things that are going to make Chase effective as his own person, and it's just kind of sad to see a clip that combines such potential alongside such hacky bullshit.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:04.679
    | text      = An even further glaring problem here is that Chase hasn't thought out the next steps down the path he's chosen.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:10.679
    | text      = Blaming Mike Johnson is great, and it takes some of the pressure off, but then what?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:14.679
    | text      = Even if all of this is Mike Johnson's fault, then you're still left with the president and the richest man in the world who are so stupid that they got played by Mike Johnson and they got into this big ego-based Twitter fight.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:25.679

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:32.679
    | text      = Chase's solution is a band-aid on a bullet hole, and while I respect the instincts, I don't know if there's really anything that anyone in his position could do to save the ship and save Musk and Trump from themselves.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:43.679

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
